description: Change who can open a recording's share link: 'public' (anyone with the link), 'restricted' (only the people and domains already on its list), or 'private' (owner only). It never invites or emails anyone. Confirm with the user before making a private recording public. Needs recordings:write.

id.description: The recording's public id (the slug in its share URL, e.g. 'a1b2c3d4e5f6') or the full https://clipy.online/video/<id> URL.

name: set_recording_privacy
